Each player votes for
another player. The
player with the most
votes may steal a soul
from another player. If
there is a tie, the active
player chooses a player
tied for the most votes.

When this enters play, the
active player secretly puts this
back in the monster deck at
least 3 cards from the top. If
this is the second time a card
named Keeper's Resting Place
resolves this game, this
becomes a soul instead
and the active player
gains it.
(+1 soul)

Choose three different
players at random. The first
puts a HP counter on a non-
eternal item they control.
The second puts a AT counter
on a non-eternal item they
control. The third puts an
eternal counter on an
item they control.
